items.html: *Know that our sages said that Adam HaRishon was punished by the shedding of limbs. The matter is that at first he was comprised of all the souls that would be throughout the six thousand years of the world's existence, as mentioned, and they were all individual limbs within him. When he sinned, they departed from him, for the Klipot ruled over him, and they all sank within the Klipot, as mentioned by us in Parashat Eikev, in the secret of the eating. Therefore, all our prayers and practical Mitzvot that we perform every day, continually, until the coming of the Messiah, serve to sort out and raise up these souls that fell from Adam HaRishon and sank within the Klipot, until “the legs shall reach the legs,” as mentioned in the Sefer HaZohar in Parashat Pekudei. And when their sorting and correction is completed, then Mashiach Ben David will come.
